issue.title: Move the remaining TUI main-thread filesystem/store I/O off the UI thread (live-watch rearm, LaunchContextSource ticks, ToolRuns modal scope, startup prompt/notification reads)
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1tz.2.1.11 notes #1, #2 and #3 and by sase-1tz.2.1.13 note #4. The sase-1tz.2.1 land agent triaged it on master fb85972f27 (2026-11-20).

Phase ui_io_offload (sase-1tz.2.1.11, commit 238ef42df9) moved the sampled synchronous filesystem work of `_launchable_mru_tick`, `hijack_row_local_deps`, and the project alias map off the TUI main thread. It used a single-flight pump-free `asyncio.to_thread` peek plus a tick-managed freshness-token cache, and added the `tests/_main_thread_fs_guard.py` regression guard, which fails on os.stat/lstat/scandir/Path.resolve called from the main thread. Several other callers still do filesystem or Rust-store I/O on the UI thread. Live low-GC stall samples from apollo and athena attribute multi-second hitches to them.

## Remaining callers

(a) **Agents apply.** `rearm_live_agent_watch_coverage` (`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_live_watch_coverage.py`) runs inside `_apply_loaded_agents_prepared`. For each live agent it calls `Agent.get_artifacts_dir` -> `_get_artifacts_dir_uncached`, which does a Rust `resolve_agent_artifact_timestamp_path` plus `Path.is_dir`. The alias-map part is now memory-only, but the path stats remain. Apollo: 128 low-GC samples on this chain, `_get_artifacts_dir_uncached` innermost n=23, max 4.4 s. Fix direction: precompute watch dirs in the loader worker, or memoize them in `_PreparedApplyData`.

(b) **Launch-context ticks.** `LaunchContextSource._tick` (`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/launch_context_source.py` ~260-300) calls `peek_current_project_change_token`, `peek_launch_default_change_token`, and `peek_active_temporary_override` on the UI thread every tick. `_schedule_project_resolution_if_needed` peeks again at ~302. Apollo: `_broadcast` n=7, plus one 71.7 s pump hitch in `load_active_overrides` via `usage_attention_enabled`. Fix direction: move the peeks into one single-flight pump-free task, as `_launchable_mru_tick` now does.

(c) **Tool runs modal.** `ToolRunsPaneShellMixin.__init__` (`src/sase/ace/tui/modals/tool_runs_pane_shell.py:115`) calls `_resolve_scope_project` -> `resolve_current_project()` synchronously when the modal opens without a project. That call runs `list_project_records`, `is_dir` on each workspace record, and `find_all_patches_cached`. Apollo sampled 0 stalls here, but it is user-initiated main-thread I/O. Resolve it in a worker, as the other current-project callers do.

(d) **Startup path** (sase-1tz.2.1.13 note #4, HEAD fb85972f27, apollo instance df9973ba):
- an 11.36 s low-GC pump stall;
- an 8.00 s stall in `src/sase/ace/tui/models/artifact_files.py:get_raw_prompt_content` -> `src/sase/agent/artifact_files_cache.py` `read_text` (`_open_text` / `_stat_signature`) and `Agent.get_artifacts_dir`;
- a 5.06 s hitch in `sase.core.notification_store_facade.read_notifications_snapshot` -> `_read_snapshot_from_rust` on the UI thread.

## Acceptance

- Each caller above does no os.stat/lstat/scandir/Path.resolve/open, and no synchronous Rust store read, on the main thread. Each one gets a `_main_thread_fs_guard` regression test that fails on the old code.
- Post-install, apollo/athena `tui_stalls.jsonl` low-GC samples no longer attribute stalls to these stacks. Record before and after counts by instance.

Size is large: four independent call sites, each needing a design choice between a worker and a cache, plus live re-measurement.

## Related

- sase-1ds: the agent-dismiss path's synchronous notification-store write and full-store read on the UI thread. A different caller, but (d)'s snapshot read may share a fix.
- sase-1tv: Agents loader worker-side stage cost.
- sase-1nc: GC pauses.
- sase-1gf / sase-lx: bench_tui_jk stall and budget failures.

task_type_fields.impact: Multi-second to tens-of-seconds TUI freezes during Agents apply, launch-context ticks, startup, and opening the tool runs modal on large-archive hosts.
task_type_fields.repro: Run the TUI on a large-archive host (apollo) with stall telemetry on and read ~/.sase/logs/tui_stalls.jsonl low-GC samples: stacks land in _get_artifacts_dir_uncached under _apply_loaded_agents_prepared (n=23 innermost, max 4.4 s), LaunchContextSource._broadcast/_tick peeks (71.7 s pump hitch in load_active_overrides), get_raw_prompt_content -> artifact_files_cache.read_text (8.00 s at startup, instance df9973ba on fb85972f27) and read_notifications_snapshot -> _read_snapshot_from_rust (5.06 s). Statically, wrapping each caller in tests/_main_thread_fs_guard.py fails today.

issue.creation_reason: The ui_io_offload phase fixed only the MRU, hijack, and alias-map callers; live apollo stall samples still attribute multi-second UI hitches to four other main-thread I/O callers, which need one owner using the same offload pattern.

payload.entry: Correction to the repro field: the last sentence ('wrapping each caller in tests/_main_thread_fs_guard.py fails today') is what the code reading predicts, not something the triager ran. Each caller still does the I/O inline on the main thread, but nobody has executed a guard test against these four callers yet. Write those guard tests first as negative controls.

payload.description: Adjacent UI-thread notification-store I/O on the dismiss path; the startup snapshot read in caller (d) may share its fix
Agents loader worker-side stage cost; caller (a) moves artifacts-dir stats into that loader, so measure both together
